title: Gravespeaker: Giving the Person Behind the Headstone a Voice
why_read: A whimsical hackathon demo app combining vision, search, and text-to-speech to generate fictionalized grave stories, interesting as a creative use case but thin on technical rigor.
analysis: Gravespeaker is a hackathon submission that photographs a headstone, uses an AI model to read the inscription, does web research via a search API, and generates a narrated story using a text-to-speech service. The engineering is mostly gluing together existing APIs (vision, search, orchestration, voice synthesis) rather than any novel technique. It's a fun creative project but offers limited new technical insight for engineers beyond seeing how these pieces fit together.
